module: Staging zone marker for dragster races: draws translucent planes on the ground with debugDrawer (start line and player line joined by side walls and regular marks). White when the position is not valid, blue when the vehicle is correctly placed, red when it has crossed the line. No scene object is created. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/dragStagePlane')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: Colors (alpha 102/255): white by default, blue (26, 89, 255) if isValidStage, red if distanceToCar > 0 without valid staging.
The actual signatures are setPlane(center, across, up, halfWidth, height) and updateFromStaging(stageTransform, distanceToStage, isValidStage); the extracted page omits the first parameter of each.
updateFromStaging expects stageTransform = {position, x, y, scale?}; the half-width is max(2.75, scale.x * 0.65) (scale.x default 4).
The intermediate marks are spaced 1 m apart along the distance to the vehicle.
Drawing happens on each update, which must be called every frame (scenario_race_marker.render does it).

init.desc: Constructor: initializes center, axes, half-width 2 m, height 0.5 m, display distance 25 m.

createMarkers.desc: Prepares an empty identifier table (no object created).

setToCheckpoint.desc: Sets the plane center to wp.pos.

setPlane.desc: Sets the plane geometry; each nil argument keeps the current value. across and up are normalized (ignored if nearly zero), halfWidth and height are clamped to a minimum of 0.05.

getShowDistance.desc: Distance from which the plane must be displayed (25 m).

updateFromStaging.desc: Updates the plane from the staging transform and the vehicle's distance to the line.

distanceToStage.desc: Distance of the vehicle to the line (m, default 0).

update.desc: Per-frame call: draws the translucent faces with debugDrawer:drawTriSolid.
